description: Rules of the required 'PR policy' check (shared-contracts §1.12). Evaluated by eng/ci/Test-PullRequestPolicy.ps1 and mirrored by tests/CheatEngine.Client.Repository.Tests/Governance/PullRequestPolicyRules.cs. All patterns are case-sensitive .NET regular expressions.

maxLength.message: Shorten the title: it becomes the squash commit subject and must fit in 72 characters.

rules.message: Remove the leading or trailing whitespace from the title.
Start the title with an uppercase letter.
Remove the prefix (for example 'fix: ' or 'SDK: '): write a plain imperative sentence.

firstWord.message: Start the title with an imperative verb (Add, Fix, Remove), not a past tense, a gerund, a third-person form or a placeholder word.

changelog.message: Consumer-visible paths changed: add an entry under '## [Unreleased]' in CHANGELOG.md, or put the line '<!-- changelog: not-needed -->' on its own line in the pull request description.
